info.title: Octo HTML Docs API
info.description: Agent-facing surface for octo-doc — the self-hosted, prompt-native interactive HTML document service (distinct from the CRDT docs-backend behind the `docs` domain). Covers the document lifecycle (publish/list/get/versions/delete), author drafts, per-doc share codes, media assets, inline comments, and the agent element read/replace + reply paths. All paths are under the `/docs-html/v1` prefix. CLI success output uses the `{ok, identity, data, ...}` envelope; failures use `{ok:false, error:{...}}`.

get.description: Owner-scoped document index. The owner check is enforced server-side; a non-owner session is rejected 403.

slug.description: Document reference: canonical doc_id for a new canonical document, or the legacy slug for an old document.

post.summary: Create an HTML document or publish a later version
post.description: Create by omitting slug; the CLI generates a fresh idempotency_key unless one is supplied explicitly. Every new document receives a canonical doc_id whether mounted or unmounted; response data.slug is the document reference and equals data.doc_id. To publish a later version, pass the previously returned data.slug in the legacy-named slug field and omit idempotency_key. An unknown legacy slug is rejected and cannot create a document. Old legacy documents continue to use their legacy slug as that reference. A display name is metadata, not identity: publishing the same name without the saved reference creates a different document, so same-name republish is not supported. Do not infer identity mode from mount_type or from whether doc_id is non-empty. Requires the write token (Bearer). The server stamps commentable artifacts and reconciles existing comment anchors.

slug.description: Legacy wire name for an existing document reference. Omit when creating. For every later publish pass the prior response data.slug: it is the canonical doc_id for a new document or the legacy slug for an old document. Never pass a display name as identity.

html.description: the full self-contained HTML document body

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller key for retrying this exact creation operation; otherwise the CLI generates a cryptographically random key once per invocation and reuses it for transport retries. Omit when republishing an existing slug.

version.description: optional explicit version; omit to auto-increment

mount_type.description: Optional placement in docs-backend and the file sidebar; 'group', 'space', and 'thread' are supported. Mounting does not determine document identity.

doc_id.description: Canonical document identifier for every newly created document. Read it at data.doc_id; do not use its presence to infer a mode.

slug.description: Document reference for all later operations. Read data.slug and persist it; for every newly created document it is equal to doc_id, while an old legacy document retains its legacy slug.

share_url.description: Share URL when supplied by the server.

registered.description: Whether docs-backend registration is active; operational status only, not an identity-mode discriminator.

status.description: Server publish/registration status; operational status only, not a document-reference discriminator.

post.description: Create a new draft without a document reference. The CLI generates a fresh idempotency_key unless one is supplied explicitly; the response data.slug is the canonical document reference for later draft save/promote and publish operations.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller key for retrying the same creation operation; otherwise the CLI generates one per invocation.

meta.description: Optional document metadata such as display title.

mount_type.description: Optional placement; does not identify the document.

slug.description: Canonical document reference; equal to doc_id.

get.description: Return a single document's metadata (slug, title, latest version, timestamps). Backend endpoint GET /docs-html/v1/docs/{doc_id} — added to octo-doc to back this command.

get.summary: List a document's per-uid access grants (author-only)
get.description: List the uids granted access to this document and their role. Author-only (only the doc creator can view grants).

parameters.name: doc_id
parameters.description: Document reference returned as data.slug: canonical doc_id for a new document, or the retained legacy slug for an old document.

put.summary: Grant a uid access to a document (author-only)
put.description: Grant a specific uid access to this document (upsert by uid). role defaults to 'reader' (read published versions + comment/react). Only the doc creator (author) can grant. The granted uid resolves to a reader capability on subsequent requests — no share code needed.

parameters.name: doc_id
parameters.description: Document reference returned as data.slug: canonical doc_id for a new document, or the retained legacy slug for an old document.

uid.description: the uid to grant access to

role.description: capability to grant; defaults to 'reader' when omitted

delete.description: Revoke a uid's grant on this document. Author-only. The doc creator cannot be removed (they own the doc) — attempting to returns a conflict.

post.description: Create a comment anchored to text or an artifact aid. Requires at least a reader capability (the doc's share code) or the write token.

post.description: Reply to a comment thread as the agent (identity odoc-agent) with an optional verdict: applied / partial / question. Requires the write token.

post.description: Return the outer HTML of a single artifact located by its stamped data-odoc-aid in a document version (version 0 = latest). Requires the write token.

post.summary: Replace one artifact's outer HTML by aid and republish (write-token gated)
post.description: Swap one artifact's outer HTML (located by aid in base_version, 0 = latest) with new_html and republish a new version. new_html must be exactly one top-level element and free of scripts / inline event handlers / javascript: URLs. Requires the write token.
